meta.name: cloud-sync
meta.description: Set up or check claude-mem cloud sync with cmem.ai Pro. Use when the user says "set up cloud sync", "sync my memories", "cmem pro", "cloud backup", "sync status", or wants their memory database backed up or synced to their cmem.ai account.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将记忆数据备份同步到云端账户
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果希望将 Claude 记忆安全同步到云端
copy.tagline_en: Back up and sync memory data to your cloud account
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to securely sync your Claude memories to the cloud

howto.what: 它会检查 claude-mem 与 cmem.ai Pro 的云同步状态，或把你从 cmem.ai → Connect 取得的 token、user id 和 SyncHub URL 写进本机设置文件，重启 worker 并验证连通。
howto.when: 当你说「设置云同步」「同步我的记忆」「cmem pro」等关键词，或想把记忆库备份/同步到 cmem.ai 账户时触发。

say.note: 会报告设备 id、待同步数量和 Hub 连通性

say.text: 帮我设置 claude-mem 云同步
云同步连不上，帮我看看报什么错
say.note: 会报告 hub.error 并请你核对三项值

howto.what_en: It checks claude-mem's cloud sync status with cmem.ai Pro, or writes the token, user id, and SyncHub URL from cmem.ai → Connect into your local settings file, restarts the worker, and verifies the connection.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you say "set up cloud sync", "sync my memories", "cmem pro", and similar, or want your memory database backed up or synced to your cmem.ai account.

say_en.note: Reports device id, pending counts, and Hub reachability
Asks for the token, user id, and SyncHub URL

say_en.text: Cloud sync isn't connecting — show me the error
say_en.note: Reports hub.error and asks you to recheck the three values
